title: Next.js analyzer graph v1 record
description: One NDJSON build-evidence record. Stream completion, ordering and joins need separate validation. Objects are extensible; unknown evidence is not empty. This is not an observed browser request trace.

size.description: Attributed bytes, not measured transfer or predicted savings.

identity.description: Exact module ident; variants can share a source path.

snapshot_name.description: Saved snapshot name. Explicit names replace earlier captures with that name.

selected_routes.description: Number of route records emitted after filtering.

meta.description: Snapshot metadata; first and unique in a complete stream.

ident.description: Exact module key used by dependency lists.

path.description: Source path, not a unique module key.

dependencies.description: Importer-to-imported ident lists; cycles are allowed.

module.description: Whole-app module graph, including when --route filters route-local records.

route.description: Unique normalized route path from routes.json.
One route; route-local records join by this path.

filename.description: Snapshot-scoped emitted path, not stable across builds or proof of a browser request.

output.description: Emitted file. Verify [client-fs]/ client-output provenance before treating it as browser work. Membership and size attribution are separate.

source_path.description: Reconstructed source path, not a unique module ident.

compressed_size.description: Attributed compressed bytes, not observed network transfer.

part.description: Source-size attribution, separate from exact module membership. Count each selected part once; directory and descendant totals can overlap.
